-- Every $2 is cast from ::text so PostgreSQL infers one type for it.
        UPDATE pages SET
          search_lang = $2::text,
          search_vector =
              setweight(to_tsvector($2::text::regconfig, $3), 'A')
           || setweight(to_tsvector($2::text::regconfig, coalesce($4, '')), 'B')
           || setweight(to_tsvector($2::text::regconfig, $5), 'C')
        WHERE id = $1
